title: Grateful Dead Live at Golden Hall on 1970-01-10
lineage: Reel (Akai GX636) -> Apogee Mini-Me (24bit/96k) -> Apogee Mini-Dac -> Wavelab 5 -> FLAC/24

ai_review.summary: A raw‑soundboard capture that holds up well, featuring an energetic Love Light and hard‑hitting jams.
ai_review.review: The recording is a soundboard source with a pleasantly raw but clear mix that many fans say sounds better than earlier copies. The show itself delivers strong energy – a standout Love Light and Pigpen‑fueled jamming that keeps the vibe high throughout. Overall it’s a solid performance that rewards listeners despite its unpolished texture.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers gave 4‑5 stars and praised both the music (especially Love Light and jam intensity) and the sound quality, indicating a good show with a decent‑to‑good recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Raw but clear mix; described as better than previous versions and reminiscent of early MIT tape ambience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Energetic performance with hard‑hitting jams; Pigpen adds fire, keeping the momentum high throughout.
